documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management reported strong financial performance for the quarter and full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and the transition toward in-house manufacturing. The company outlined its strategic focus on scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the revenue contribution of manufactured goods to 50%, and expanding binder sales into non-textile industries. Furthermore, management noted that internal accruals and strong cash flows are expected to support future requirements and debt reduction. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year of fiscal 2026, highlighting growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax.

guidance.claim: Management expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA can increase by 200 to 300 basis points upon complete plant utilization.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve a 50%-50% revenue mix between trading and manufacturing.
guidance.quote: Right now, . Like it is in trading and manufacturing right now what we did as of now was 75%-25% that will become 50%-50% .

guidance.claim: The management expects to close the current year with a top line of approximately INR110 crores.
guidance.quote: Sir, in our last con call, we had said that this year we would close around INR110 crores. So are you still maintaining that guidance or has something changed? Tushar Sanghavi: No, of course the same. These two months, January and February, have also gone well for us. Prateek Chaudhary: So, you will cross approximately INR110 crores top line? Tushar Sanghavi: Hoping so, for your good wishes is also there.

guidance.claim: At full utilization, the 500-ton capacity manufacturing plant can generate a total turnover of around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects growth rates of 15% to 20% in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% in the wood coating market.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company is encouraged by improving demand trends in the wood coating segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports by eliminating duties.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing as Bangladesh faces challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production costs, and stricter compliance requirements.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara plant facility is spread over 10 acres of land with a 72,000 square feet automated setup.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: Further vessel expansion in the current facility would cost approximately INR 3 crores to INR 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned an automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, shifting to a manufacturing-led model.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production has commenced at the company's first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated plant and an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The new facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process with advanced automation, process controls, and zero carbon footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: The facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process combined with advanced automation and process controls, which ensuring consistent product quality and high throughput and zero carbon footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added a Kochi office during the quarter for domestic wood coating products.
capex_expansion.quote: And in this quarter, we added the Kochi office for domestic wood coating products.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: The manufacturing segment EBITDA margins are around 20% to 25%, while the trading business is 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Proactive inventory strategy has helped secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, providing near-term margin stability.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin for Q4 FY26 was reported at 33.2%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (%) 33.2% 39.0% -580 bps 25.0% 820 bps 28.2% 25.8% 240 bps

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 stood at 23.1%.
Q3 revenue grew by 5.38% year-on-year to INR33.54 crores, while EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: In quarter 3 financial year '26, the company reported a revenue of INR33.54 crores, growing by 5.38% year-on-year. On a quarter-on-quarter basis, revenue recorded a sharp 78.54% increase compared to the quarter 2 of the financial year '26. The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded by 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in Q3 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax rose by 117.4% to INR4.06 crores with the PAT margin improving by 620 basis points to 12.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax also showed strong growth, rising by 117.4% to INR4.06 crores with PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara plant has an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first two months of operation (November and December), the plant utilized around 60% of its capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Management does not expect working capital to become a constraint due to internal availability and good cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: So, Nidhi ji, basically we aren't expecting that working capital as such should become any constraint in our growth, mostly because internal availability is there, and more than that our cash flow is very good.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the manufacturing plant funding, INR30 crores is a bank loan and INR20 crores was funded through the IPO (for land purchase of INR10 crores) and internal accruals/unsecured loans from promoters.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: The long-term loan of INR30 crores taken for the manufacturing plant has a tenure of 7 years with a moratorium ending in June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Our term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores. Nidhi, can you hear me? Nidhi: Yes, yes. Okay. Okay. So how does management plan to manage the current debt to net worth position as manufacturing operations stabilize? Tushar Sanghavi: There is no major capex is on card. So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores. Nidhi: Okay, okay. Noted. So sir, this long-term loan of INR30 crores that we have taken for the manufacturing plant, what will be its tenure? Tushar Sanghavi: It is 7 years. Nidhi: 7 years. Okay and moratorium period? Tushar Sanghavi: It is June '26.

capital_allocation.claim: The short-term borrowings carry an interest rate of 8.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile due to global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: New machinery will be added over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

management_commitments.claim: New products may be launched from ongoing R&D within 3 to 4 months.
management_commitments.quote: Since sorry to interrupt, our R&D is also going on, so maybe within 3-4 months we can launch some new products also, so we may expand little bit with the capacity of the vessels also.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: By looking at the demand across the market, the company hopes to achieve full capacity utilization by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: Within 1 to 2 years, the company expects trading and manufacturing revenues to be equal, with 50% import and 50% in-house manufacturing.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, that is the question which I am looking that you will you may ask some questions like this. Anyway, but in coming years our trading and manufacturing we are expecting that it would be equal. Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.
